messages:
renee: heads-up: noticed a cluster of invoice complaints — customers on discounted tiers showing full-price tokens for a 45m window starting ~02:12 UTC. stats show discount_tag missing from billing.events for rerouted requests. anyone on routing? :grimacing:

sam: ugh. was a capacity-fallback rollout at 02:10 UTC for dedicated pools. fallback routing swaps model_variant and tags a `fallback_reason`, maybe we dropped other metadata.

oscar: quick check in clickhouse: rows with fallback_reason != NULL have discount_tier NULL ~98% of the time during the window. non-fallback requests keep discount_tier fine.

julia: that implies the router's emit path creates a fresh event and forgets to merge request-level billing metadata. we recently refactored the router to emit via the new internal API `meter.emit(v2)` — looks like v2 requires an explicit `merge_context` flag.

renee: can we do a quick patch to carry `discount_tier` through? low-risk: change router to copy all `billing_meta.*` into emit payload before calling meter.emit(v2). also add a regression test.

oscar: will add the patch. also propose telemetry: counter `billing.event.missing_discount_on_fallback` incremented when fallback and discount_tier missing. alert if >100 in 15m.

sam: agree. also add dashboard card comparing `discounted_token_share` pre/post rollout. SQL sketch: 
```sql
SELECT bin, sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE discount_tier IS NOT NULL) / sum(tokens) as discounted_share
FROM billing.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY bin
ORDER BY bin DESC
```

deploy-bot: hotfix branch created: fix/router-emit-merge. staging deploy queued.

oscar: after patch, we should run a short canary at 0.5% traffic for 30m and verify `billing.event.missing_discount_on_fallback` stays near zero. if green, roll to prod and run a backfill for the 6h window to restore the discount_tier for affected events.

julia: backfill plan: idempotent job that joins request_id -> original billing_meta snapshot and re-emits downstream correction events to ledger (no invoice mutation). coordinate with billing-ops and legal for customer-facing comms.

renee: add runbook entry "discount_tag lost on fallback" with mitigation steps, dashboard link, and who to page. sam, oscar, please update runbook.

sam: will update runbook and dashboard. target mitigation deploy in 45m.

oscar: staging deploy succeeded. canary started. posting canary metrics in 10m.

billing-bot: alert created: billing.event.missing_discount_on_fallback > 100 in 15m -> paging oncall-billing.

renee: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll keep invoice-audit looped for potential backfill. :thumbsup:
